create_DDPPOTrainer: create a DDPPOTrainer instance with a Habitat config to initialize distributed DD-PPO training
setup_actor_critic_agent: setup the actor-critic agent with AudioNavBaselinePolicy and DDPPO algorithm for audio navigation
run_train_loop: run the distributed DD-PPO training loop with rollout collection, agent updates, and checkpointing
resume_interrupted_training: resume interrupted DD-PPO training by loading saved state dict, optimizer state, and LR scheduler
configure_rollout_storage: configure RolloutStorage for DD-PPO with observation space, action space, and hidden size parameters
